parsed.note_claim: Tap water used for nasal irrigation risks rare but fatal infections from amoebas, so distilled, sterile, or boiled/cooled water should be used instead.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: An amoeba called Naegleria can cause a life-threatening brain condition called primary amebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) if you ingest it. Most cases associated with nasal irrigation involve people who used untreated tap water.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms that amoebas in untreated tap water can cause life-threatening infections during nasal irrigation and recommends using distilled or boiled water instead.
